author: ORDEM
title: ORDEM hiring artists for collections
content: ORDEM is looking for artists to help bring the next worlds, characters, and ideas to life. Opening opportunities for artists to create collections through ORDEM, with a guaranteed minimum artist payout, a share of primary mint proceeds, and potential secondary royalty participation. Styles welcome: illustration, 3D, digital, traditional, experimental. DM us or join the ORDEM Discord and reach out to the team. Contact: DM @ordemworld or ORDEM Discord.
